# Crayon Roofing & Structures — Sales Call Knowledge Base (auto-distilled)

## Corpus summary

This corpus is a large batch of short, raw call-center snippets (mostly inbound/outbound dealer and site-engineer calls, mixed Tamil/English) for Crayon Roofing & Structures, a Chennai (Manali / Andarkuppam check-post) based metal-roofing-sheet and accessories trading company. The great majority of real sales value lives in a **repeated set of rate-enquiry calls** ("rate enna irukku", "square meter rate sir") for JSW colour-coated roofing sheets (Coloron Plus, Pragathi, Radiance, Kalaran) and the Asian/Indradhanush alternative brand, plus a smaller but consistent stream of enquiries for **puff/PUF sandwich panels, polycarbonate sheets, GI accessories (L-flashing, ridge, gutter, cutter, down-pipe), purlins/square-pipe, and Tata-brand screws/electrodes**. A large fraction of the raw audio is NOT sales (logistics/loading/Porter-vehicle chatter, internal "who-told-whom" arguments, wedding invitation calls, voicemail, garbled Hindi/Tamil fragments) — these have been excluded. Because the surviving sales calls are short, transactional, and repetitive (many near-duplicates), this KB is built from pattern-repetition across ~60 genuine rate/order/objection calls rather than a handful of long, rich conversations. Treat rates below as **snapshots on specific call dates** — the calls themselves repeatedly state that prices are volatile and change multiple times a month.

## Products & brand ladder

**1. Colour-coated metal roofing sheets (core product)**
- Brand ladder, cheapest → premium, as stated by reps across calls:
  - **Asian Indradhanush** — entry brand, PPGI range, available only in 0.45mm thickness, colours Sky Blue / Off White.
  - **JSW Pragathi** — mid brand, Sky Blue / Off White, 0.47mm commonly stocked.
  - **JSW Coloron Plus** — "top quality" brand repeatedly recommended; 0.47mm and 0.50mm (also 0.60mm mentioned); widest colour range: Sky Blue, Off White, Brick Red, Graphite/Pencil/Dark Grey, Royal Blue (Nova Blue), Mist Green, Non-colour "Bare".
  - **JSW Kalaran**, **Radiance** — occasionally quoted as alternates, usually priced between Pragathi and Coloron Plus.
  - **Galvalume (AZ70 / PPGL / PPGI / "Steel Bare" / "Silver")** — uncoated/metallic sheet for buyers who don't need colour (car-parking, tender bids).
- Thickness range actively sold: 0.35mm (rare, needs MOQ/tonnage check), 0.45mm, 0.47mm, 0.50mm, 0.60mm (0.72/0.80mm only for large coil MOQ, e.g. 25 metric tons).
- Standard width on billing: ~1.0–1.08 meter profile width; length made-to-order up to ~6.7m/22ft per piece due to vehicle length limits.

**2. PUF / Puff insulated sandwich panels**
- Thicknesses sold: 30mm, 40mm, 50mm (30mm is the minimum — "20mm இல்ல sir, 30mm தான் starting").
- Company explicitly **does not fabricate/fit** — "நாங்க insulation பண்ண மாட்டோம், supply மட்டும்தான் பண்றோம்." Pricing is roof vs wall dependent, and company sources puff from a third party, so reps must check with "Sir" before quoting.

**3. Polycarbonate sheets** — blue sheet, 2mm thickness standard (3mm/1.8mm not normally stocked); priced per running-meter/KM basis, not flat sheet rate (₹800+GST per square/KM mentioned).

**4. Accessories (GI/metal) sold alongside sheets**
- Ridge, L-flashing, gutter (e.g. 150×75mm), patch board, flashing cutter, deep-trim, down-pipe — all quoted **per piece at 2.5m standard length**, with price banded by *width*: ≤610mm width vs 610–1220mm width (down-pipe adds ~₹250 extra over base accessory rate).
- Purlins / square & rectangular MS pipe (sizes like 100×100, 40×40) sold by size+thickness (1.6/2/3mm).

**5. Fasteners & consumables (Tata brand)**
- Tata screws (stitch screws 19mm, 25mm, 130mm; hex-head screws), Tata welding electrodes, Tata cutting/grinding wheels — sold in cartons/boxes (e.g., 1 carton 25mm = 5000 screws; small box = 500–700 screws).
